description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius 3. Your goal is to document the skull morphology by creating a 3D surface model and exporting three standardized anatomical views.

1. Create a bone segmentation mask (e.g., using the 'Bone' preset: 226-3071 HU) and generate a 3D surface.
2. Manipulate the 3D viewer to show the **Anterior view** (Norma Frontalis - front of skull) and export it as a PNG to `/home/ga/Documents/norma_frontalis.png`.
3. Manipulate the 3D viewer to show the **Right Lateral view** (Norma Lateralis - right side of skull) and export it as a PNG to `/home/ga/Documents/norma_lateralis.png`.
4. Manipulate the 3D viewer to show the **Inferior view** (Norma Basilaris - base of skull from below) and export it as a PNG to `/home/ga/Documents/norma_basilaris.png`.

Ensure the skull is centered and visible in all exported images.
